title: 第3章 它听懂了
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
孙兽医来到的时候，天已经快黑透了。

    他是被罗川从村西头硬拽过来的，裤腿上全是泥点子，手里提着一只半旧的药箱，气喘吁吁的，进了罗家院子先弯腰喘了半天。

    孙兽医大名孙有福，五十出头。

    黑土县周围七八个村子里的牲畜都归他管理。

    如果发现某家的【黑水牛】不吃草了、某家的【啄虫鸡】不下蛋了、某家的【拉车牛】腿瘸了，都需要找他汇报。

    他并不是来自正规学出来的御兽师。

    没考过功名，就是在年轻的时候在镇上的药铺当过几年的学徒。

    之后拜了一位走乡串户的老兽医为师，学到了很多土法子，并且跟一个叫【衔药獾】的小兽签了一份契约。

    这几年就靠着一个人、一只獾在乡下混饭吃。

    衔药獾蹲在它的脚边，毛色是灰褐色的，身子很胖，头上有条白色的纹路从鼻子尖一直延伸到后脑勺，像是用石灰画出的线。

    它的前爪比普通的獾要粗壮一圈，指缝之间有泥土，指甲尖上还沾着几根没有来得及抖落的草根。

    这是它擅长做的。

    衔药獾可以嗅到泥土中药草根茎的存在，并且能够挖掘出三尺深埋藏的灵药。

    找到后直接含在嘴里，用唾液将食物混合后，敷在伤口上，起到止血、促进组织再生的效果，比药店里卖的膏药和成药要好许多。

    孙兽医蹲在牛棚外，拿着罗川送来的油灯，在仔细查看老黑身上的伤痕。

    衔药獾现在已经自己动了，不用孙兽医的命令，它绕着老黑转了两圈。

    鼻子贴着地面嗅了嗅，然后一头钻进了牛棚旁边的草垛底下。

    泥土翻飞，没一会儿它就叼着一团黑乎乎的根茎钻了出来，在嘴里嚼了几口...

    凑到老黑额头的断茬处，小心翼翼地将嚼碎的药糊一点一点地抹了上去。

    老黑哼了一声，身体微微发抖，但是没有躲开。

    它伏在地上，两只前腿蜷缩在身下，一双大眼睛时而睁开、时而闭上，并不时地瞄一眼蹲在旁边的罗影。

    孙兽医一边查看伤口，一边絮絮叨叨地说着话，也不管有没有人接茬。

    这是他的一种习惯，看了几十年的牲畜，嘴上闲不住。

    他砸巴嘴道：

    “断得倒是干净，根部没有碎裂，好歹没伤到颅骨......

    这头牛命大，换一头牛，这样撞法，脑袋早就碎了...

    觉醒二级的基础支撑起身体，骨头硬，算是保住了一条命。”

    用手指轻触断口附近的一些肉，老黑闷闷地发出一声哞。

    【衔药獾】又钻了一趟地，叼回来一撮细白的须根，和着先前的药糊重新抹了一层，用舌头舔平了边缘。

    孙兽医从药箱中取出一块粗棉布，在老黑的额头上缠了几圈，打结。

    站起来，拍拍自己的膝盖上沾的泥土。

    然后看着罗长庚、罗川二人斟酌了一下后，轻声说道：

    “命是保住了。”

    “但一个月内不能下地。”

    “一点重活都干不了。”

    “它把体内存留的精气都灌到牛角里去了。

    这时候身体上亏空得厉害，得养养。”

    罗川手里拿着灯杆，紧紧握着。

    一个月不能下地。

    秋天的播撒就在眼前了。

    没有老黑拉犁用，罗川只好自己拿锄头来刨地，五亩地，刨到年底也刨不完。

    可他没说出口。

    现在不是算这笔账的时候。

    孙兽医又蹲下身来，捡起地上那对已经断裂的牛角，仔细端详了一番。

    手指甲在角面上弹了两下，眉头微微皱起。

    将牛角贴近油灯下面，灯光照射到角上时，角面上会泛出一层暗青色的光泽，就像有什么东西固定在了角质当中。

    沉默了一会儿之后，惊叹道：

    “稀奇。”

    “我这十里八乡，治过的【黑水牛】，没有千头，也有几百头了。”

    “见过不知道有多少对角。”

    “这对角的质量...

    比我自己见过的大多数觉醒二级的牛角都要好。”

    “你摸摸这个分量，实沉。

    寻常二级牛角中间是空的，这对是实心的，灵气渗得透，纹路也正。”

    “拿到县城兽材铺子去，能值六两。”

    六两。

    这个数字就好似一块石头一样，落在了牛棚里的每个人的心头。

    罗川的手不由得微微发抖，油灯里的火焰也随之颤动了一下。

    六两银子。

    正好是县学一年的束脩。

    分毫不差。

    老黑安安静静的趴在地上，额头上面缠着一条粗棉布条，从这里流出来的血已经被药物糊住了，在布条上只留下一圈暗红色的痕迹。

    它听不懂六两有多少。

    但它大概知道，自己做的那件事，做对了。

    所以它眯着眼睛，鼻孔里喷出一股热气，把嘴边的草屑吹得滚了几寸远。

    显得很放心。

    孙兽医叹了一口气，从药箱底下摸出一个记账的小本子，舔了舔笔尖，写了几行字。

    说道：

    “出诊一趟，药材、獾子的灵粮消耗，加上敷药，一共五百文。”

    他说这话的时候语气很平，跟报菜名似的。

    平常要不了那么多...

    这算是大伤。

    乡下兽医收的钱不多也不少，童叟无欺。

    罗长庚点了点头之后，就用手撑着门框想要站起来到房间里面拿钱。

    这时【衔药獾】叫了一声。

    不像是叼到药材之后兴奋的短叫，而是低沉而闷的呜咽。

    蹲在老黑旁边，歪着头看了一眼老黑额头上的伤口，又扭过头来看了罗影一眼，再回头看了看自己的主人。
content_en:
When Vet Sun arrived, it was almost dark.
He was dragged over from the west end of the village by Luo Chuan. His trouser legs were covered with mud. He was holding a half-used medicine box in his hand. He was panting. He bent down and panted for a long time after entering the Luo family yard.
Vet Sun, whose name is Sun Youfu, is in his early fifties.
He manages the livestock in seven or eight villages around Heitu County.
If you find that a certain family's [black buffalo] stops eating grass, a certain family's [insect-pecking chicken] stops laying eggs, and a certain family's [drawing oxen] is lame, you need to report to him.
He is not a formally trained beast master.
He never passed the examination and worked as an apprentice in a drug store in the town for several years when he was young.
After that, I became a disciple of an old veterinarian who traveled from village to village, learned a lot of traditional methods, and signed a contract with a little beast called "Medicine Badger".
In the past few years, I have relied on one person and a badger to make a living in the countryside.
The medicine badger squatted at its feet. Its fur was grey-brown and its body was very fat. There was a white stripe on its head that extended from the tip of its nose to the back of its head, like a line drawn with lime.
Its front paws were thicker than those of an ordinary badger. There was mud between the fingers, and there were a few grass roots that had not been shaken off on the tips of the nails.
This is what it's good at doing.
The medicinal badger can smell the presence of medicinal rhizomes in the soil and can dig out elixirs buried three feet deep.
After finding it, put it directly in your mouth, mix the food with saliva, and apply it on the wound to stop bleeding and promote tissue regeneration. It is much better than plasters and patent medicines sold in pharmacies.
Vet Sun was squatting outside the cowshed, holding the oil lamp sent by Luo Chuan, and carefully examining the injuries on Lao Hei's body.
The medicinal badger was now moving on its own without any orders from Veterinarian Sun. It circled around Lao Hei twice.
He put his nose to the ground and sniffed, then dove under the haystack next to the cowshed.
The soil was flying, and soon it came out with a bunch of black roots in its mouth, chewing a few mouthfuls...
He came close to the stubble on Lao Hei's forehead and carefully applied the chewed medicine paste bit by bit.
Lao Hei snorted and trembled slightly, but did not move away.
It was lying on the ground, its two front legs curled up under its body, its big eyes sometimes opening and sometimes closing, and occasionally glancing at Luo Ying squatting next to it.
Veterinarian Sun was talking nonstop while checking the wound, regardless of whether anyone was talking to him or not.
This is a habit of his. After watching the livestock for decades, he can't stop talking.
He slapped his mouth and said:
"The break was quite clean, the roots were not broken, and the skull was not damaged at least...
This cow is very lucky. If it were another cow, its head would have been broken long ago...
The foundation of the second level of awakening supports the body and the bones are strong, which can be regarded as saving a life."
He lightly touched some meat near the fracture with his fingers, and Lao Hei let out a muffled moo.
[Medicine-Holding Badger] burrowed into the ground again, picked up a handful of fine white fibrous roots, and applied a new layer with the previous medicinal paste, and licked the edges with his tongue.
Vet Sun took out a piece of cheesecloth from the medicine box, wrapped it around Lao Hei's forehead several times, and tied it into a knot.
Stand up and pat the dirt on your knees.
Then he looked at Luo Changgeng and Luo Chuan and said softly after considering it for a while:
"My life was saved."
"But you can't go to the ground for a month."
"Can't do any heavy work."
“It poured all the energy retained in its body into the horns.
At this time, the body is severely deficient and needs to be nourished."
Luo Chuan held the lamp pole in his hand and held it tightly.
Can't go to the ground for a month.
Autumn sowing is just around the corner.
Without Lao Hei to pull the plow, Luo Chuan had to use a hoe to dig the land himself. Five acres of land could not be cleared by the end of the year.
But he didn't say it.
Now is not the time to settle this score.
Vet Sun knelt down again, picked up the pair of broken horns on the ground, and looked at them carefully.
His fingernails flicked on the corners twice, and his brows furrowed slightly.
Put the horn close to the bottom of the oil lamp. When the light shines on the horn, a dark blue sheen will appear on the horn, as if something is fixed in the horn.
After being silent for a while, he exclaimed:
"Strange."
“I have treated hundreds of [black buffaloes] in my area from ten miles to eighty miles away, if not thousands.”
"I've seen countless enemies."
"The quality of this pair of corners...
Better than most of the level 2 awakened horns I've seen myself."
"You feel the weight, it's really heavy.
Usually the middle of the second-level horns is hollow, but this pair is solid, with spiritual energy permeable and the lines correct."
"Take it to the animal material shop in the county. It's worth six taels."
Six taels.
This number fell like a stone on everyone's mind in the bullpen.
Luo Chuan's hands couldn't help but tremble slightly, and the flame in the oil lamp also trembled.
Six taels of silver.
It happened to be the end of the first year of county school.
Exactly.
Lao Hei lay quietly on the ground, with a strip of cheesecloth wrapped around his forehead. The blood flowing out from here had been covered by the medicine, leaving only a circle of dark red traces on the strip.
It cannot understand how many six liang there are.
But it probably knew that what it did was right.
So it squinted its eyes, blew out a stream of hot air from its nostrils, and blew the grass clippings around its mouth a few inches away.
He seemed very relieved.
Vet Sun sighed, took out a small accounting book from under the medicine box, licked the tip of the pen, and wrote a few lines.
said:
"One medical visit, medicinal materials, badger's spiritual food, plus application, total 500 Wen."
When he said this, his tone was very calm, as if he was announcing the name of a dish.
Normally it doesn't cost that much...
This is a serious injury.
Rural veterinarians charge neither too much nor too little, and they are fair-minded.
After Luo Changgeng nodded, he supported the door frame with his hands and wanted to stand up and go into the room to get the money.
At this time [Medicine Badger] barked.
It's not like a short cry of excitement after taking the medicine in his mouth, but a low and muffled whimper.
Squatting next to Lao Hei, he tilted his head and glanced at the wound on Lao Hei's forehead, then turned to look at Luo Ying, and then looked back at his master.
